//: install.ps1 writes this file to the installation folder as appsettings.Pilot.json.
Everything real lives under C:\ProgramData\RCS\Pilot, never inside the installation folder and never inside
the source repository, so reinstalling or replacing the release cannot touch documents, previews or keys.
NO SECRETS HERE. The local database is reached over trusted local authentication, or with a password in
%APPDATA%\postgresql\pgpass.conf owned by the employee's Windows account.

ConnectionStrings.//: Loopback only. A single-laptop pilot has no network listener of any kind, database included.

Review.//: Never true. The host refuses to start with the demonstration actor enabled outside Development.

Authentication.//RequireSecureCookie: false ONLY because this pilot is http://127.0.0.1 on one laptop: the cookie never leaves the machine. A LAN or server deployment keeps it true behind TLS.

//: Previews need poppler, libvips and LibreOffice, and the sandbox needs bubblewrap, none of which exist on
Windows. The launcher therefore ships with previews OFF: documents upload, download and are listed
normally, and the UI says 'Ön baxış mümkün deyil' honestly rather than failing silently.
A laptop pilot that needs previews runs the LAN/server package instead (sections 1-12).

Hosting.//DataProtectionKeysPath: Session cookies stay valid across restarts and reinstalls because the keys live outside the release folder.
